programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: A riveting action comedy. A realtor is pulled back into his old life by his former partner-in-crime. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past.

programme.title: Freaky - Este Corpo Fica-Me A Matar
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton play a game of cat and mouse in this slasher comedy. After a girl swaps bodies with a serial killer, she has less than 24 hours to change back.

programme.title: Medieval
programme.desc: Starring Ben Foster and Michael Caine, this is an epic take on the true story of Jan ika, one of Czech history's greatest warriors, who is said to have never lost a battle.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Five Fingers For Marseilles
programme.desc: Lives change forever when Tau, the young lion, kills two corrupt policemen in a South African shanty town.

programme.title: The Day We Didn't Meet
programme.desc: A great South African film. Alex and Sam reconnect after a chance encounter. They imagine a fantasy life together and abandon all their responsibilities. However, reality sets in.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Spud
programme.desc: Based on the South African best-seller, this insightful and funny coming-of-age film looks at a young boy's journey into manhood that begins in the halls of boarding school.

programme.title: Dog
programme.desc: Channing Tatum drives this heartfelt drama. A former Army Ranger and a military dog are paired against their will on the road trip to a fellow soldier's funeral.

programme.title: Richard The Stork 2
programme.desc: Richard, the daring sparrow who was adopted by a stork family, is back for another adventure. He embarks on a solo journey when he realises he won't be his flock's leader.

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Family Business
programme.desc: Now adults, estranged brothers Tim and Ted must work together again on a Baby Corp mission to defeat a new villain. Features the voices of Alec Baldwin, Eva Longoria and James Marsden.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: Get ready for some good, wholesome fun in this animated joyride. A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity to rally along the famous Silk Road trade route.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Excellent performances and great music turn this movie into a smash hit. A new recruit helps transform an all-girl singing group's sound, leading them to take on a boy band.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: An action thriller piloted by Gerard Butler. A pilot saves his passengers from a storm by landing on a war-torn island, putting all of them in the path of dangerous rebels.

programme.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
programme.desc: Henry Golding and Andrew Koji drive this action-packed G.I. Joe spin-off. A tenacious loner is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan, but his honour and loyalty are tested.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: In this psychological horror with dark humour, singer Brandy Norwood finds herself facing a mother-in-law from hell when a pregnant couple takes in the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: 31 Million Reasons
programme.desc: Brothers Ronnie and Jugs are two Chatsworth policemen who hatch a plot to seize 31 million rands from a cash deposit facility.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Jenna Ortega and Martin Freeman are entangled in a complex situation in this thriller about a teacher-student relationship that unravels through a special writing project.

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: Chad Michael Murray and Bruce Willis star in this action thriller. A grieving battle veteran's life is disrupted when a cop and a drug cartel arrive on his property.

programme.title: Skemerson
programme.desc: A young man battling mental illness decides to kill himself by jumping off the Bloukrans Bridge. On the bridge, he meets someone who sets his life on a completely different path.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: Cute romantic comedy with funny woman Tina Fey (30 Rock). A Princeton admissions officer has a tough choice to make when she meets an applicant who could be the son she gave up for adoption.

programme.title: Spud 2: The Madness Continues
programme.desc: John Cleese is back as the razor-sharp English teacher in the follow-up to the 2010 South African hit comedy that introduced moviegoers to the coming-of-age journey of Spud.

programme.title: The Honeymooners
programme.desc: Cedric The Entertainer and Mike Epps are a hilarious comedic duo in this tale of a dreamer and his sidekick, who run into trouble after investing in a money-making scheme.

programme.title: Dr Seuss' The Lorax
programme.desc: Danny DeVito and Zac Efron bring a Dr. Seuss classic to life in this wondrous animation. In a world without trees, a young boy embarks on a journey to bring them back.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch takes on the iconic role in this rendition of the classic tale. The super grumpy Grinch plots to ruin Christmas for the villagers of Whoville.

programme.title: Bee Movie
programme.desc: Looking for a family film with a moral and Jerry Seinfeld's observational humour? Then the story of Barry, the bee who leaves the hive for a big adventure, is just up your path.

programme.title: How To Save The Immortal
programme.desc: An epic animated adventure about Russia's fairytale villain. Forced to kidnap a girl, hardened bachelor Koschey embarks on an adventure that makes him a hero he never expected.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: The Barden Bellas contend with bigger competition and even bigger scandal this time around. Elizabeth Banks (The Hunger Games) makes her directorial debut with this box-office hit.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Denzel Washington and Ryan Reynolds must survive the streets of Cape Town in this high energy action film. After a safe house is attacked, a CIA agent must protect his charge.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: Jon Hamm drives this crime comedy. After becoming the prime suspect in multiple murders, Fletch strives to prove his innocence as he looks for his fiance's stolen art collection.

programme.title: Saw X
programme.desc: The tenth film in the horror franchise, with Tobin Bell returning. Set between the events of SAW I and II, John Kramer plots his twisted revenge on the doctors who conned him.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: A slain soldier (Vin Diesel) is resurrected with superhuman powers by advanced technology, and proceeds to seek revenge for the murder of his wife.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: A Finnish soldier turned gold prospector sets out to retrieve the cache he found that was later snatched by Nazi forces led by a pitiless SS officer.

programme.title: The Doorman
programme.desc: A gang of thieves targets a rich New York family, not realising the building's doorperson, an ex-combat veteran, will do anything to protect them.

programme.title: Fear Below
programme.desc: Ruthless criminals and down-on-their-luck divers end up tangling with a vicious bull shark as both groups attempt to recover a cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Jade
programme.desc: A grieving woman with a unique set of skills scuppers the plans of a gang leader and a businessman, both looking for data that could destroy Interpol.
